name: file-signature
description: A signed document or signature field.
useCase: Identify a file containing a signature or an action to sign a document.
misuse: Do not use the handwritten mark alone as proof that a signature is valid.

16.reason: The handwritten mark keeps its tall leading curves and an open finishing stroke at text size.

24.reason: The full handwritten flourish ends lower, leaving clear space between its free tip and the preceding curve.
